type LiteralKey = { [k: 'x']: number };
interface GenericKey<T> {
  [k: T]: number;
}
type BooleanKey = { [k: boolean]: number };
class UnionLiteralKey {
  [k: 'a' | 'b']: number;
}
type AnyKey = { [k: any]: number };
type MixedKey = { [k: string | boolean]: number };
type ObjectKey = { [k: object]: number };
type KeyofKey = { [k: keyof { a: 1 }]: number };
type NeverKey = { [k: never]: number };
type MappedKey<T extends string> = { [k: Lowercase<T>]: number };
type Letters = 'a' | 'b';
type AliasKey = { [k: Letters]: number };
type UnknownKey = { [k: `a${number}`]: number; [j: unknown]: number };
type TwoBad = { [k: bigint]: number; [z: string | 1]: number };
class GenericUnionKey<T> {
  [k: number | T]: number;
}
type Name = string;
type Valid = {
  [k: Name]: number;
  [n: number]: number;
  [s: symbol]: number;
  [t: `a${string}`]: number;
  [u: Uppercase<string>]: number;
};
type Branded = { [b: string & { brand: 1 }]: number };
